primitives.name: Market-implied Skellam calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Calibration:** convert the bookmaker's correct-score odds matrix to implied probabilities (p = 1/(1+odds)), rescale to remove vig, aggregate to score-difference probabilities, then estimate (λ^A_t, λ^B_t) by matching the first two moments — minimizing **D_E2 + D_V2** (mean/variance residuals) subject to λ ≥ 0 (paper's equation 16).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{E2}': 'Mean residual sum of squares between observed and predicted score-difference means', 'D_{V2}': 'Mean residual sum of squares between observed and predicted score-difference variances'}
primitives.assumptions: Poisson scoring assumption, score independence, vig-rescaled odds as unbiased probability estimates
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-scoring games, heavy right tails, small-sample binning

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal predictive intervals via moment-matching duality; also maps to GSE's Kalman-filtered state transitions when extended to time-varying covariates.
layer2.telemetry: Residual mean-square error on held-out score-difference distributions; Brier score improvement over raw moneyline-implied probabilities.

primitives.name: Implied volatility Skellam
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Extension sketched: time-varying log-linear Skellam regression **log(λ^A_t) = α_A + β_A X_{A,t-1}** on in-game stats (possession, shots, corners, cards).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'σ_{IV,t}': 'Implied volatility (dimensionless)', 'λ^{A}_t, λ^{B}_t': 'Time-varying Poisson rates (goals per unit time)'}
primitives.assumptions: Market efficiency, Black-Scholes risk-neutral pricing intuition applied to discrete score increments
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low-scoring games, sudden goal shocks, stoppage-time effects

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's live volatility surface via state-transition dynamics; also maps to GSI's uncertainty quantification through variance propagation.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation with actual score increments; predictive power for next-period score-range width.
